Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek - Enable headset mic of Acer X2660G with ALC662

The Acer desktop X2660G with ALC662 can't detect the headset microphone
until ALC662_FIXUP_ACER_X2660G_HEADSET_MODE quirk applied.
